claims.text: Before rendering, the browser constructs DOM and CSSOM trees
claims.quote: Before the browser can render the page, it needs to construct the DOM and CSSOM trees.

claims.text: DOM and CSSOM combine into a render tree used for layout and paint
claims.quote: The CSSOM and DOM trees are combined into a render tree, which is then used to compute the layout of each visible element and serves as an input to the paint process that renders the pixels to screen.

claims.text: Layout computes position and size of each object
claims.quote: Layout computes the exact position and size of each object.

claims.text: Paint renders the pixels to the screen
claims.quote: The last step is paint, which takes in the final render tree and renders the pixels to the screen.

claims.text: DOM and CSSOM are built from HTML and CSS input
claims.quote: we built the DOM and the CSSOM trees based on the HTML and CSS input.

claims.text: Render tree contains only nodes required to render the page
claims.quote: Render tree contains only the nodes required to render the page.
